[soft, slightly weary voice] Just one more video. [quietly realizing] Suddenly, it's two-oh-seven A.M.

[clear, conversational voice] That's doomscrolling. Screen-time limits count minutes, NOT what you watch.

[warm, inviting voice] Meet REDU: a privacy-first Android app that notices doomscrolling, and helps you pause.

[clear, informative voice] Built for adult Filipino Android users who watch short-form video.

[focused, explanatory voice] Three signals: session length, time per video, and negative captions. Fuzzy logic combines them into a doomscrolling risk score.

[gentle, reassuring voice] When it rises, REDU steps in gently: a reminder, a pause, then a breathing break. You stay in control.

[calm, confident voice] It all runs on your phone, and raw content is never kept.

[measured, positive voice] In a two-week pilot with fifty Filipino adults, prompted users scrolled less, and saw less negative content.

[warm, encouraging voice] REDU. Notice the scroll. Choose the pause.
